ultraterraforged.gui.button.alluvialFans: Cones of gravel and sand spreading out where steep valleys open onto flat land at the foot of mountains, mostly in dry climates
ultraterraforged.gui.button.atolls.toolt: Rings of coral reef far out in warm seas, with low sandy islets and a shallow lagoon inside
ultraterraforged.gui.button.barrierIslan: Long, thin islands of sand just off flat coasts, broken by inlets, with a calm, shallow lagoon behind them
ultraterraforged.gui.button.blueHoles.to: Deep, round, sheer-sided pits in warm, shallow seas
ultraterraforged.gui.button.buttes.toolt: Flat-topped towers of rock with sheer cliffs, from narrow buttes to broad, sometimes stepped mesas. They stand in badlands, on plateaus and on flat desert and savanna land
ultraterraforged.gui.button.canyons.tool: Winding, branching dry canyons with walls stepped into ledges, cut into badlands and plateaus. With rock layers on, their walls show the bands of rock
ultraterraforged.gui.button.caveMouths.t: Cave entrances open in hillsides, cliffs and gorge walls rather than as holes in flat fields
ultraterraforged.gui.button.climateSeedO: A seed offset used to randomise climate distribution
ultraterraforged.gui.button.coastalIslan: Islands standing a little way off the coast on the shallow shelf, some tied to the mainland by a sandbar
ultraterraforged.gui.button.continentSha: Controls how continent shapes are calculated. You may also need to adjust the transition points to ensure beaches etc still form.
ultraterraforged.gui.button.coralReefs.t: Reefs of living coral growing up almost to the surface off warm coasts
ultraterraforged.gui.button.customBiomeF: Use custom biome features in place of vanilla ones (such as trees)
ultraterraforged.gui.button.deltas.toolt: Where a big river meets the sea on a flat coast, it fans out into branching channels between marshy islands and sandbars
ultraterraforged.gui.button.drumlins.too: On cold lowlands, what old ice sheets left behind: swarms of smooth, oval hills all lying the same way, and long, low ridges of rubble
ultraterraforged.gui.button.dunes.toolti: Fields of sand dunes on the flat land of hot deserts, with long, wavy crests across the prevailing wind
ultraterraforged.gui.button.erosionDecor: Steep and high ground loses its soil: bare rock on cliffs, coarse dirt and loose gravel on slopes
ultraterraforged.gui.button.fancyMountai: Carries out extra processing on mountains to make them look even nicer. Can be disabled to improve performance slightly.
ultraterraforged.gui.button.fjords.toolt: On cold and rainy coasts the sea floods up the valleys between the mountains, in long, branching inlets between steep ridges
ultraterraforged.gui.button.giantCaverns: Rare, huge chambers deep underground, with stone pillars and a lake on their floor
ultraterraforged.gui.button.glacialValle: In cold mountains, valleys worn by old glaciers into U-shaped troughs with flat floors and steep walls, and round cirque bowls under the peaks holding small lakes that spill over in waterfalls
ultraterraforged.gui.button.glacierCaves: Tunnels of blue ice leading into the mountainside from glacial valleys and cirques
ultraterraforged.gui.button.headlands.to: A ragged coastline: rocky points reaching out into the sea between sheltered bays and coves
ultraterraforged.gui.button.islandArcs.t: Curved chains of volcanic islands out in the open sea, with craters and dark volcanic rock
ultraterraforged.gui.button.karst.toolti: In warm, wet lands, limestone worn away by rain: clusters of steep tower hills, sinkholes, and cenotes, sinkholes open down to water
ultraterraforged.gui.button.karstCaves.t: Great chambers and passages under karst country, with potholes dropping into them and pools on their floors
ultraterraforged.gui.button.largeOreVein: Set whether large ore veins spawn
ultraterraforged.gui.button.lavaTubes.to: Long, round tunnels running downhill from volcanoes just under the ground, lined with basalt, with collapsed skylights
ultraterraforged.gui.button.layerCaves.t: Wide, low caves running level along the rock layers, so a cliff face shows their mouths in rows
ultraterraforged.gui.button.naturalSnowD: Removes snow from the terrain where it shouldn't naturally settle
ultraterraforged.gui.button.oreCompatibl: Only use rocks that ores can generate in. When off, rocks such as tuff, calcite and other mods' decorative stones are layered too, and those hold no ores
ultraterraforged.gui.button.peninsulas.t: Long arms of land reaching out from the coast into the sea, narrowing and bending towards their tip
Rivers, lakes and wetlands keep their water a few blocks below their banks, high in the hills as well as by the sea, instead of all cutting down to sea level
ultraterraforged.gui.button.ridges.toolt: Long ridges across the deep ocean floor, split by a rift valley where hydrothermal vents smoke with magma
ultraterraforged.gui.button.riverBanks.t: River and lake beds and banks that suit their setting: gravel and cobbles in the mountains, sand and clay in the lowlands, and mud in wetlands and deltas
ultraterraforged.gui.button.riverIslands: Islands in lakes, and long islands splitting wide rivers into channels
ultraterraforged.gui.button.riverSeedOff: A seed offset used to randomise river distribution
ultraterraforged.gui.button.rockShelters: Overhangs worn into the foot of cliffs in badlands and canyons, like the shelters of cliff dwellings
ultraterraforged.gui.button.salt.tooltip: A random seed value for the structure.
ultraterraforged.gui.button.saltFlats.to: Dead flat, pale basins of salt crust on the low ground of hot, dry deserts, like dried up lake beds
ultraterraforged.gui.button.sandWaves.to: Rippled ridges of sand on the shallow sea floor, lined up with the currents
ultraterraforged.gui.button.seaCaves.too: Caves cut into sea cliffs at the waterline, flooded by the sea, and arches right through narrow headlands
ultraterraforged.gui.button.seaCliffs.to: Stretches of coast where the land ends in a sheer cliff over the sea, with a rocky shelf instead of a beach
ultraterraforged.gui.button.seaFloorSedi: Sand in the shallows, and sand, gravel and clay further out, over the sea floor, rather than bare rock; the rock still shows on steep slopes
ultraterraforged.gui.button.seaStacks.to: Pillars of rock standing in the sea off the cliffs
ultraterraforged.gui.button.seamounts.to: Underwater mountains rising from the deep, some with flat tops worn off long ago
ultraterraforged.gui.button.shelves.tool: A broad, shallow shelf off every coast, ending in a clear drop-off into the deep sea
ultraterraforged.gui.button.skerries.too: Swarms of small, bare rocky islets off cold coasts
ultraterraforged.gui.button.smoothLayerD: Modifies layer block levels (ie snow) to fit the terrain
ultraterraforged.gui.button.spawnType.to: Set whether spawn should be close to x=0,z=0 or the centre of the nearest continent
ultraterraforged.gui.button.spits.toolti: Narrow bars of sand curving out from the coast into the sea
ultraterraforged.gui.button.springs.tool: Water welling out of small caves in hillsides and running down the slope
ultraterraforged.gui.button.stoneErosion: Keeps the rock laid bare on steep slopes plain stone, so the layers only show in caves, ravines and deep cuts
ultraterraforged.gui.button.strataDecora: Fills the underground with bands of stone, granite, diorite, andesite and other mods' natural stones that show in cliffs, caves and ravines, like layers in a canyon wall. Replaces vanilla's scattered blobs of those rocks
ultraterraforged.gui.button.structureEna: Whether this structure set generates at all
ultraterraforged.gui.button.submarineCan: Deep, winding canyons cut into the shelf, running from near the coast out over the drop-off
ultraterraforged.gui.button.terrainSeedO: A seed offset used to randomise terrain distribution
ultraterraforged.gui.button.tors.tooltip: Outcrops of bare rock on hilltops: blocky stacks of rock slabs, with boulders strewn around them
ultraterraforged.gui.button.trenches.too: Long, narrow, curving chasms plunging far below the deep ocean floor
ultraterraforged.gui.button.undergroundR: Long, winding tunnels deep under the land with a river flowing along their floor
ultraterraforged.gui.button.vanillaLavaS: Allow vanilla springs (lava source blocks) to generate
ultraterraforged.gui.button.vanillaSprin: Allow vanilla springs (water source blocks) to generate
ultraterraforged.gui.button.volcanicSurf: Lava over magma in volcano craters, basalt, blackstone and tuff on their cones, and patches of old lava flows on the land around them
ultraterraforged.gui.button.whaleFalls.t: The bones of great whales lying on the deep sea floor
ultraterraforged.gui.button.windingRiver: Rivers move off their straight courses onto the lowest ground nearby, winding around hills and along valleys rather than climbing over them or cutting gorges

ultraterraforged.gui.performanceMods.mod: Fixes memory leaks in Minecraft and many mods.
Generates, loads and saves chunks on many threads at once: the biggest speed-up for exploring new land.

An add-on for C2ME that moves parts of world generation onto the graphics card. Optional: it needs Java 25 and a graphics card with OpenCL, and doesn't work together with Noisium(ed), so install one or the other.
Speeds up ticking, mob AI, physics and parts of world generation, without changing how the game plays.
Cuts loading times and memory use.
Fills new chunks with blocks faster, without changing the terrain. Noisium itself is no longer updated; Noisiumed is its maintained fork.
Renders the world far faster, for smoother frame rates and longer view distances.
